_description: What-if scenarios of the case study (Section 3.3.2); implemented by scripts/04_scenario_modelling.py

scenarios.label: S0
scenarios.name: Current state
scenarios.description: Baseline (2024): lecture halls with constant air volume (CAV) systems controlled by volume flow (outdoor air per floor area).

scenarios.label: S1
scenarios.name: Classrooms CAV-person
scenarios.description: As Scenario 0, but the CAV systems of the classrooms are controlled on the airflow per person.

scenarios.label: S2
scenarios.name: Classrooms VAV-person
scenarios.description: Variable air volume (VAV) systems in the classrooms modulating the airflow per person on the occupancy schedule, with a minimum flow (0.15 L/s m2) when unoccupied.

scenarios.label: S3
scenarios.name: Classrooms +20% capacity
scenarios.description: Classroom seating capacity (people per floor area) increased by 20%.

scenarios.label: S4
scenarios.name: Classrooms -20% capacity
scenarios.description: Classroom seating capacity (people per floor area) reduced by 20%.

scenarios.label: S5
scenarios.name: Classrooms fully occupied
scenarios.description: Classrooms 100% occupied during all their booked hours; classroom equipment follows the occupancy schedule.

scenarios.label: S6
scenarios.name: Classrooms half occupied
scenarios.description: Classrooms 50% occupied during all their booked hours; classroom equipment follows the occupancy schedule.

scenarios.label: S7
scenarios.name: Classrooms 75% occupied
scenarios.description: Classrooms 75% occupied during all their booked hours; classroom equipment follows the occupancy schedule.

scenarios.label: S8
scenarios.name: Classrooms 25% occupied
scenarios.description: Classrooms 25% occupied during all their booked hours; classroom equipment follows the occupancy schedule.

scenarios.label: S9
scenarios.name: Closed offices CAV-volume
scenarios.description: Classrooms repurposed as closed offices (0.12 people/m2, 8.1 W/m2 equipment, generic office schedule) with CAV systems controlled by volume flow.

scenarios.label: S10
scenarios.name: Closed offices CAV-person
scenarios.description: As Scenario 9, with CAV systems controlled on the airflow per person.

scenarios.label: S11
scenarios.name: Closed offices VAV-person
scenarios.description: As Scenario 9, with VAV systems modulating the airflow per person on the office occupancy schedule (minimum flow when unoccupied).
